concepts.name: Classic gallery
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished square app icon for SART Gallery, a personal art gallery on a Samsung TV. This is a brand icon, not a landscape painting, not a room mockup. Exact text: 'SART' as the dominant word, and 'GALLERY' as a smaller but clear secondary word. The name must be spelled accurately and be visually central. Strong, deliberate typography and a gallery-frame concept. Full-bleed opaque square, clean front-facing composition, legible at small app icon size and from across a room. No S-only monogram, no television hardware, no photographic scenery, no mockup, no multiple variations in one image, no extra words, no watermarks. Produce the icon artwork itself. Direction 1: a timeless gallery identity. Deep ink navy background, thick warm ivory picture-frame border with generous inside space. Large beautifully drawn high-contrast editorial serif SART in warm ivory, composed as one horizontal word; smaller tracked sans-serif GALLERY underneath. A restrained brushed bronze accent on the frame. Flat graphic design, precise proportions, sophisticated museum signage, simple and highly readable. Typography occupies most of the framed interior. No illustration inside the frame.

darkModeEdit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this selected SART Gallery app icon into its dark-mode counterpart. Preserve the exact composition, geometry, lettering, letter spacing, frame-corner positions and thickness, square accent position, proportions, and square canvas. Change only its colours. Replace the warm ivory background with a uniform deep charcoal ink background close to #101419. Replace the near-black SART and GALLERY lettering with warm ivory close to #f5f3ee for clear high contrast. Keep the four frame corners bronze, using a slightly lighter muted champagne bronze close to #b99a65 so they remain readable against the dark background. Keep the terracotta square accent, close to #ba633d. Preserve the subtle tactile finish. The exact text must remain SART and GALLERY, with identical typography and placement. No new elements, no extra words, no layout changes, no 3D effects, no glows, no rounded-square outer frame, no mockup. Deliver the final dark icon itself.
